cohort: 250 pregnant patients at term, divided into 123 with isolated oligohydramnios (amniotic fluid index <= 5cm) and 127 with normal amniotic fluid volume.
finding: Isolated oligohydramnios at term is not associated with adverse perinatal outcome.
mod_finding: Cesarean delivery rate was higher in the oligohydramnios group (46.3%) compared to the normal amniotic fluid group (21.3%).
birth_weight: Lower in the oligohydramnios group (2.6 +- 0.34 kg) vs the normal amniotic fluid group (3.0 +- 0.33 kg)
